original: ato 'ntarā caturdaśadinād arvāg ity ārthaḥ | nanūrdhvam api caturdaśadinād dhanaṃ datvā bandhakam ṛṇī kim iti nāpnoti, svatvadhvaṃsakābhāvāt | dhanadvaiguṇyam avadhibhūtakālātikramaṇaṃ ca taddhvaṃsakam iti cet, na, dānavikrayāder eva taddhvaṃsakatvāt | ādiśabdaparigṛhītavargāntargataṃ dvaiguṇyādikam apīti cet, na, svatvadhvaṃsakatayā lokaprasiddhānām evādiśabdena parigrahāt | dvaiguṇyādikam api tatheti cet, na — na hi loke dvaiguṇyādes tathā prasiddhir asti | ucyate — satyaṃ dvaiguṇāder nasty eva tathā prasiddhiḥ, dravyavinimayasya tu tathā prasiddhir asty eva tilavikrayapratiṣedhād vikrayākaraṇe 'pi vinimayena tilānāṃ svatvanivṛttidarśanāt | tataś cātrāpi kṛtakālādhau ṛṇagrahaṇakāla eva yady [331] aham iyatā kālena na dadāmi tadādhir evānṛṇyāya tava bhaviṣyatīti dhanikarṇikayor dhanavinimayasaṃpratipatter jñātatvād avadhibhūtakāle svatvadhvaṃso yukta eva | etad eva nāśanimittaṃ yājñavalkyena "kālakṛtaḥ" ity anenoktam | dvaiguṇye tu yad api ṛṇagrahaṇakāle yady ahaṃ dvaiguṇye 'py ādhiṃ na mokṣayāmi tadādhir evānṛṇyāya tava bhaviṣyatīti dhanikarṇikayor dhanavidhimayasaṃpratipattiniyamābhāvaḥ | tathāpi yatraiveyaṃ saṃpratipattiḥ kṛtā tatraiva dvaiguṇye svatvadhvaṃsaḥ, hetusadbhāvāt, tadviṣayaṃ ca "ādhiḥ praṇaśyet" iti vacanam ity anavadyam | evaṃ krayapratigrahādyabhāve 'pi vinimayenaivādhau dhanikasya svatvāpattiḥ vrīhyādāv iva tilaviniyamakartur iti yuktam uktam "bandhakasya dhanī svāmī" iti | dvisaptadinapratīkṣaṇaṃ tu vinimayadārḍhyajñānārtham uktam | dravyavikrayāder iva dṛḍhavinimayasaiva svatvadhvaṃsādinimittatvāt | evaṃ ca "ato 'ntarā dhanaṃ datvā" ity api vacanaṃ yuktam eva | yat tu bṛhaspatinoktam,

original: dvyarthīṃ cāyaṃ granthaḥ | ekas tāvad arthaḥ | svacchāśayādhamarṇāṅgulīyakādyalpamūlyaṃ (?) bandhakam abhūt tac caritrabandhakam, tena kṛtam upāttam ṛṇam adadatam adhamarṇam uttamarṇāya savṛddhikaṃ rājā dvaiguṇyād ūrdhvaṃ dāpayed iti | anyas tu: caritraṃ iṣṭāpūrtādiko dharmaḥ, sa eva bandhakam ādhiḥ tena kṛtam ityādi samānam | evaṃvidhe [335] tv ādhau dhanam aprayacchato 'dhamarṇasya nāsty ānṛṇyam ity abhiprāyaḥ | akṛtakālaphalabhogyādhāv apy ānṛṇyam adharmarṇasya dhanadānata eva nānyataḥ, phalabhogād avṛddhikatve 'pi mūlānapāyāt | na cādhinaiva tad apāya iti vācyam, yad āha sa eva: "phalabhogyo na naśyati" iti | mūladhāpradāne tavaivādhir bhaviṣyatīti vinimayasaṃpratipatter dhanagrahaṇānantarakṣaṇa eva mūladhanāpradānād ādhināśāpattyāsaṃbhavanirastatvād anyasya nāśakasyāvidyamānatvād ity abhiprāyaḥ ||

original: saṃskārā jātakarmādyā upanayanāntā vivakṣitāḥ, avaśyakāryā ity abhidhānāt | vivāhādisaṃskārasya tu naiṣṭhikatvādipakṣāntaradarśanād avaśyakāryatābhāvāt saṃskāraśabdasya saṃkoco 'tra vivakṣita ity anavadyam | kanyakānāṃ tu vivāhāntāḥ saṃskārā upanayanarahitāḥ pitryārthābhāve svārthād uddhṛtya kāryāḥ, vivāhasyopanayanasthānatvenāvaśyakāryatvāt | vibhāgakāle 'nyad api dhanaṃ kanyakā svadhṛtālaṃkārādikaṃ labhata ity āha śaṅkhaḥ: "vibhajyamāne dāyādye kanyālaṃkāre vaivāhikaṃ strīdhanaṃ ca kanyā labhet" iti | dāyādye dāyadhane bhrātṛbhir vibhajyamāne kanyā svadhṛtālaṃkāraṃ vaivāhikaṃ turīyāṃśādidhanaṃ strīdhanaṃ ca pitrādinā dattaṃ labhed ity arthaḥ | bodhāyano 'pi: "mātur alaṃkāraṃ duhitaraḥ sāṃpradāyikaṃ labheran anyad vā" iti | sāṃpradāyikaṃ mātṛparaṃparāyātam | anyat tad itarad vā mātrā dhṛtam alaṃkāraṃ mātṛkaṃ tatra vibhajyamāne duhitaraḥ kumāryo labherann ity arthaḥ ||
analyzed: saṃskārāḥ jātakarma ādyāḥ upanayana antāḥ vivakṣitāḥ avaśya kāryāḥ iti abhidhānāt vivāha ādi saṃskārasya tu naiṣṭhika tva ādi pakṣa antara darśanāt avaśya kārya tā bhāvāt saṃskāra śabdasya saṃkocaḥ vivakṣitaḥ iti anavadyam kanyakānām tu vivāha antāḥ saṃskārāḥ upanayana rahitāḥ pitrya artha abhāve sva arthāt uddhṛtya kāryāḥ vivāhasya upanayana sthāna tvena avaśya kārya tvāt vibhāga kāle api dhanam kanyakā sva dhṛta ala
